text_block_list.text:
A shooting star streaks across the autumn 
skies of Yodo. The crowd roars in 
excitement at the birth of a rising star.

Praise it! Revere it! From here on, the 
solo becomes a duo—!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Bwahahahahaha!! Now then!! It's time for 
Ayabe-san's debut race!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...And loudly, almost too loudly, Admire 
Vega's classmate and self-proclaimed 
"Supreme Overlord," TM Opera O's voice 
roars across the grandstand.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Our friend, guided by the stars of 
destiny— we have to be there to witness 
her first big stage."

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Ah, but Doto!! Today of all days, the 
spotlight belongs to Ayabe-san!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Please be terribly watchful that the 
radiance I unconsciously emit does not 
eclipse the starlight!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
U-Understood~...!! Be careful if it's 
sparkling... careful...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Oh, it's so sparkly~!!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Bwahahaha! Forgive my intrusion!!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Hawawaa... But surely Ayabe-san will run 
dazzling races from now on too, won't 
she~?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"I'm so glad I made it to watch~ When I 
got on the wrong train for the seventh 
time, I wasn't sure what would happen, 
but~..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A fellow classmate who, despite her 
timidness, possessed true grit: Meisho 
Doto. It seems she exhibited another 
off-the-charts display of clumsiness 
today.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And—

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Because the two of you were there, I was 
able to make it this far~. With Opera 
O-san, and—

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Huh? Huh, wait? Where did they go~...?
—Whoa! You became a fan? Of mine?

text_block_list.name: Top Road Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Ever since I saw you in the recent 
"Tracine Academy's Top Promising Talents 
Feature"...!

text_block_list.name: Top Road Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Because you were sooo cooool, Narita Top 
Road-san~~!!

text_block_list.name: Top Road Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Her running is just so powerful!! Man, oh 
man, I'm rooting for her so hard~!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, thank you so much! Your support 
makes me really happy.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
She's currently training for her debut 
race, so it will be just a little longer 
of a wait, but—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I'll do my absolute best to repay all the 
faith you've placed in me with real 
results!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I'd really appreciate your continued 
support from here on out!

text_block_list.name: Top Road Fan A
text_block_list.text: Hawawa... S-So refreshing...!

text_block_list.name: Top Road Fan B
text_block_list.text:
And that straightforward way they come 
right at you! Supporting them is just way 
too rewarding...!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Doto-chan, Opera O-chan! Sorry about that, 
we were just chatting a bit.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Hawawa, Top Road-san... She's as popular 
as ever, yes she is...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Standing alongside T.M. Opera O and Meisho 
Doto as a rising star of this generation, 
Narita Top Road—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She, too, had come to watch Admire Vega's 
Make Debut.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Ah! It's almost time for the paddock. ...I 
wonder if Ayabe-san is done getting ready 
too.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
—Alright, let's cheer at the top of our 
lungs, both of you!

text_block_list.name: Opera O & Doto
text_block_list.text: Of course!! Y-Yes-suh～!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...And when I told her that I had seen a 
lively trio in the stands...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I see.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I thought it might ease her tension even 
slightly, but having prepared so 
stoically, Admire Vega might not have 
needed such consideration."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even so—I think to myself, as my gaze 
suddenly drifts down to her feet.
choice_data_list: How are your legs feeling? Any problems?
How are your legs feeling? Any problems?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I'm fine.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
If there's any problem or abnormality, 
I'll report it. ...You don't need to ask 
every single time.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Treated with care, yet unable to show it 
in return.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...Meaning, you can't give a favorable 
reply.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Don't go out of your way just to make 
yourself miserable.
choice_data_list: I don't find you unpleasant at all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I replied with a slight chuckle. After 
all, I had already gotten the only answer 
I needed to my question: "Condition is not 
a problem."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I'm not asking for a polite or cheerful 
response. No matter how I'm treated, I 
chose of my own accord to 'support them 
anyway.'"
choice_data_list: You can just look straight ahead and run.

It's okay for you to just look forward and 
run.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"You don't have to look back. You don't 
have to worry about me. Even if that's the 
case—"
choice_data_list:
Wherever you're headed is where my path 
leads.
Wherever you go, that is my path.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I see.

text_block_list.name: Staff Member
text_block_list.text:
Time's up! All Make Debut runners, please 
assemble in the paddock!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I'm heading out.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Now, the promising, up-and-coming 
Umamusume making their debut are about to 
enter the paddock.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Which of these Umamusume will seize 
victory here on the grounds of Kyoto 
Racecourse—?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOAAAHH!)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: (Ah... I can tell. ...It's trembling.)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
(The faint remnants of you left inside 
me... —Are trembling with sheer joy and 
anticipation.)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ......I'm going to win.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I promise you, I'll win—!!
